scope.matrix: Runtime main render chain: exact fighter and variant, neutral, walking, jump, ordinary and explicit supported attacks, guard, recoil, KO poses and staged presentations.
scope.counting: One phase slot per fighter variant and named phase. Distinct file-and-key receipts are deduplicated in uniqueDrawnKeys. Walk slots record the availability of one or more keys. Shared poses are identified separately.
scope.missing: No matching admitted image key for this exact state phase. Each row lists its native artwork and any articulated fallback. The idle slot tracks the distinct idle key in the combat atlas.
scope.excluded: New direction and rear plates, alternate choreography, all pairwise grapples, finishers, environmental effects, transitions and wider Bible animation demands require separate visual review. Dedicated drawing counts use admitted image keys only.
scope.supplementary: Ripostes, movement controls and ground recovery are tracked separately from the main phase totals. Guard retreat and ground recovery draw existing keys where the runtime admits reuse.
scope.nativeEvidence: Asset registration only, not all states played in a browser. Native source art identity stays attached to each variant. Scenario JSON can include reference sprite alterations in project designs independently of canon.
